dialogues.speaker: Avena
dialogues.text: I think I'll go explore over there next!

dialogues.speaker: Lemta
dialogues.text: Miss, with all due respect, your adventure plan...

dialogues.speaker: Avena
dialogues.text: Oh, I know, I haven't forgotten! But isn't it the Sabzeruz Festival that's going on right now?

dialogues.speaker: Avena
dialogues.text: How could I not throw myself, body and soul, into such an important holiday?

dialogues.speaker: Lemta
dialogues.text: Your whole body and soul and one thing, but if you throw your whole wallet at the festival too, you won't have anything left to cover adventuring expenses, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Avena
dialogues.text: Oh, wallet schmallet! That's where you're wrong. You can't eat money, it's meant to be spent!
